seoDescription: AppRafter privacy policy. Currently in preparation; minimal data-collection summary below.
heading: Privacy.
bodyHtml:
A formal privacy policy is in preparation. While the project is pre-MVP and AppRafter does not host customer workloads, here is the minimal data-collection summary. It applies to apprafter.dev and to the documentation site at docs.apprafter.dev.

What we collect

  • Server access logs (IP, user-agent, request path) — retained 30 days for abuse mitigation.
  • Aggregate page-view counts, on both sites, through Plausible Analytics — our one third-party processor. It sets no cookies, stores no identifier in your browser, and builds no profile: a visit contributes to a count and to nothing else. We can see that a page was read; we cannot see that you read it, and we cannot follow you to any other site.
  • Email address you submit via the managed-launch waitlist — used exactly once, for a launch announcement.
  • An optional one-liner about your use case — used to gauge interest, never published.
  • An optional opt-in for a discovery call — triggers a single follow-up email with a Calendly link.

What we don’t do

  • No tracking in the sense the word usually means: no advertising pixels, no cross-site cookies, no identifier that follows you between visits or between sites, and no profile of any individual. Our analytics is a counter, and it is named above rather than left implicit.
  • No mailing list. The waitlist is a one-shot announcement channel, not a newsletter.
  • No data sale or transfer to third parties.

Removal

Want your email removed from the waitlist before launch? Send a message to hello@apprafter.dev and we delete the record.

When the formal policy ships it will replace this stub. The source of truth will move to a Payload LegalPages collection so updates don’t require a code deploy.
